messages:
Priya M: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a per-layer toggle + customer-override flag for mixed-precision profiles. Want quick take on safety surface and metrics to watch.
Theo R: What's the UX for customer-override? API param or account setting? Also how do we restrict dangerous combos?
Priya M: Two-tier: API hint `precision_preference` (soft) + account policy `precision_lock` (hard). Lock only for enterprise customers.
Sam T: Ops: if customer locks to very low bitwidth (4-bit), we need circuit-breakers for latency/regression spikes and cost alerts. Add budget guardrails.
Lina: From model side: per-layer toggles help for attention/feedforward divergence. But we need per-layer performance profiles (latency/cosine loss). Where stored?
Priya M: Store profiles in profile-store (per-model, per-variant). Each profile line: layer_name, bitwidth, perf_delta, qual_delta. Example: `FFN_12,4b,+0.8ms,-0.9%`.
Aria QA: For quality, we should track three signals: anchor-exact, open-nli-sim, and hallucination-rate (entity-drop). Define alert when any moves beyond thresholds for 30m window.
Theo R: How do we compute hallucination-rate cheaply? NLI over every response is expensive.
Aria QA: Heuristic: entity-presence check + sampled NLI (5% of traffic). Entities extracted via fast regex/token heuristics.
Sam T: Runtime note: per-layer switches may ruin KV cache packing. Recommend we surface `kv_pack_miss_delta` and `avg_latency_per_token` in canary dashboards.
Priya M: Good catch. We'll add `kv_pack_miss_delta` to rollback triggers. Also add `cache_invalidation_count`.
Theo R: Can we simulate the quality/perf tradeoff offline before canary? Like synthetic replay to estimate qual_delta and latency on candidate GPU/quant kernel?
Lina: Yes. We have an offline harness that runs 10k replayed traces at target batch sizes. Need to expand to include per-layer bit flips and pack/unpack overhead.
Priya M: Proposed rollout sequence: offline sims -> shadow replay on staging -> 0.5% canary read-only -> 2% mirror -> ramp. Rollback windows: immediate (5m), short (30m), medium (2h).
Sam T: Owners: ML owns qual thresholds and profiles, Ops owns runtime kill and budget caps, Product signs off customer-locks. Add to runbook.
Aria QA: Also add a drift detector: if qual_delta slowly increases over 24h (trend test), trigger full_recompute of quant calibration.
Theo R: For API, expose `precision_preference: [auto|balanced|quality|cost]` and `precision_overrides: {"layer_regex": "4b"}` but restrict overrides to admin scopes.
Priya M: Will do. Add telemetry fields: `applied_profile_id`, `precision_preference`, `override_token_count`, `kv_pack_miss_delta`, `hallucination_rate`, `anchor_exact_delta`.
canary-bot: Canary job started: per-layer-override-experiment #378 -> canary 0.5%
Sam T: Reminder: add a hard emergency kill route in console that sets `precision_mode=baseline`. It must be one-click with audit log.
Lina: Also ensure quant kernels emit diagnostic histograms (scale distribution, zero-count) so we can detect saturations that cause degeneration.
Priya M: I'll update RFC with runbook snippet and telemetry keys, and add an entry to onboarding checklist for new models. Thanks everyone.
Theo R: I'll draft the API shape and add admin RBAC notes.
Aria QA: I'll prepare a 100-anchor and 500 open-sample set for the offline sims.
Priya M: Plan: offline sims this week, staging shadow next Wed. Tagging follow-up for Friday sync.
